item: Exclude retired redirect source URLs from site search
scope: Local production build, real content inventory and browser proof. No live indexing, ranking or lead-lift claim.

implementation.redirectPolicy: One shared routing configuration, reused by Next and the server search builder
implementation.filter: Exclude literal unconditional redirect sources after document scoring
implementation.noindexPolicy: Keep the three live campaign pages searchable; keep existing utility exclusions

acceptance.npm ci: PASS, exit 0; five existing high advisories
acceptance.npm run typecheck: PASS, exit 0; repeated after restoring generated next-env.d.ts

regression.before: Fails on retired engineered-septic landing page in actual inventory
regression.after: 137 passed, 0 failed; existing search quality suite also passes

limitations: Parameterized legacy routes currently match no generated search URLs. Production filtering covers literal redirect sources; all compiled patterns were checked against the full final inventory.
An initial SEO run flagged legacy routing strings when the shared configuration was placed under lib. Moving routing definitions to config resolved this without changing validators.
Shared-kit reservation failed on its existing missing configured root; notebook ownership was recorded and shared configuration was left unchanged.
evidence: Hobby scheduler job wades-plumbing-hobby-1028-1139: per-command receipts, before/after inventory, compiled routes, HTML/browser comparisons and reviewed screenshots
